scripts.test:icon-transform: vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/icon-transform.test.ts test/icons/icon-ssr-fixture.test.ts test/icons/solid-fragment-normalization.test.ts test/icons/solid-icon-ssr-fixture.test.ts test/icons/colorful-fragment-normalization.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/components/icon-fragment-runtime.test.tsx test/components/icon-public-runtime.test.tsx test/components/solid-icon-fragment-runtime.test.tsx test/components/solid-icon-public-runtime.test.tsx test/components/colorful-icon-fragment-runtime.test.tsx test/components/colorful-icon-public-runtime.test.tsx
scripts.test:icons:solid: vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/solid-source-sync.test.ts test/icons/solid-paint-semantics.test.ts test/icons/solid-fragment-normalization.test.ts test/icons/solid-icon-ssr-fixture.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/components/solid-icon-public-runtime.test.tsx test/components/solid-icon-fragment-runtime.test.tsx && pnpm run test:types
scripts.audit:icons:outline: node scripts/audit-icons.mjs --check --policy outline-v1 --manifest config/icon-sources/outline.json#manifest --index src/outline/index.tsx --name-catalog src/figmaNameCatalog.ts --outline-name-manifest config/icon-sources/outline.json#manifest --outline-name-index src/outline/index.tsx --outline-name-raw-provenance config/icon-sources/outline.json#raw --outline-name-placement-provenance config/icon-sources/outline.json#placement --solid-name-manifest config/icon-sources/solid.json#manifest --solid-name-index src/solid/index.tsx --solid-name-raw-provenance config/icon-sources/solid.json#raw --solid-name-placement-provenance config/icon-sources/solid.json#placement
scripts.audit:icons:solid: node scripts/audit-icons.mjs --check --policy solid-v1 --manifest config/icon-sources/solid.json#manifest --index src/solid/index.tsx --name-catalog src/figmaNameCatalog.ts --outline-name-manifest config/icon-sources/outline.json#manifest --outline-name-index src/outline/index.tsx --outline-name-raw-provenance config/icon-sources/outline.json#raw --outline-name-placement-provenance config/icon-sources/outline.json#placement --solid-name-manifest config/icon-sources/solid.json#manifest --solid-name-index src/solid/index.tsx --solid-name-raw-provenance config/icon-sources/solid.json#raw --solid-name-placement-provenance config/icon-sources/solid.json#placement --figma-raw-provenance config/icon-sources/solid.json#raw --placement-provenance config/icon-sources/solid.json#placement
scripts.audit:icons: pnpm run audit:icons:stroke && pnpm run audit:icons:adjustable && pnpm run audit:icons:outline && pnpm run audit:icons:solid && pnpm run audit:icons:colorful
scripts.test:icon-adjustable: vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts test/icons/icon-adjustable-transform.test.ts test/icons/icon-adjustable-audit.test.ts test/icons/icon-adjustable-ssr.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/components/icon-adjustable-runtime.test.tsx
